TV setup (first time)
  1. Settings → Device preferences → About → tap Build 7×
  2. Settings → System → Developer options → enable USB debugging
  3. Enable Network debugging / wireless debugging if available
  4. Some TVs need a one-time USB pairing; others expose port 5555 after adb connect
